title: 乙醇：SMILES、ETKDG、MMFF94 与 Mesh Apply

required_steps.description: prepare GUI inspect/convert ethanol.smi，区分无来源坐标与派生平面显示
CBQ Preview/Import 并创建分子 View
Generate 3D (ETKDG)，固定参数并核对完成状态
Edit Mode 改动一个原子并 Apply Mesh，旧实体和旧 View 保留
Cycles 渲染、保存配对工程

input.origin: repository-authored synthetic molecular input CCO; execution must use the actual installed backend

reference.optimizer_success: CalculationStatus.SUCCESS and optimizer_status=0; otherwise report actual incomplete status
reference.energy_reference: Independent RDKit MMFF94 evaluation on the same saved atom mapping, topology and coordinates, frozen before operation; optimized energy must not exceed pre-optimization energy beyond tolerance
reference.apply_reference: One selected atom displaced by +0.15 angstrom along Z in Edit Mode; new Structure UUID; source arrays and old View binding unchanged

note: Frozen before T02 execution. Ethanol does not test aromatic resonance; Kekulize on its all-single-bond graph must preserve connectivity. MMFF94 is not quantum computation. Native GUI JPEG is accepted by user decision 2026-09-10; final render stays PNG.
